renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Sit quiet and be happy. Use very few words — call off the chatter in your head. Ask what this is, how, who you are — and don't doubt the asking. What shines without breaking, making yes and no both shine — that open is God's house, the most real thing there is.
If you only find the real by first throwing out the unreal — all you found is the unreal. And calling the unreal real doesn't make it real, not like that.

Nothing that shines stands apart from shining — even the different bit doesn't shine twice. So drop the grabbing at how things break. Dreams? Just plays, nothing scary. And first decide you want knowing and doing and measuring — then tell me, teacher: what makes you different from a stone? Even stones throb — so aren't you the house of un-split knowing, with no beginning, no end, nothing to grab, all true?

You light up every living thing — if they smear you, so what? Shining or not, you stay whole — awake forever, either way. Now throw your eyes past every target. Copying God without being God is a con. Where everything is awake-as-one, there is no outside — and no inside either.
When wanting bubbles up — whatever flashes, just watch that. Beginning, middle, end — if you're there, you shine, you shine, and everything melts into you.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Sit still, be glad. Few words — mute the chatter in your head. Ask what, how, who — no doubting the ask. What shines unbroken, lighting up yes and no both — that void is God's place, the realest real.
Find the real only by first yeeting the unreal? Congrats, you found the unreal. Calling unreal real doesn't make it so. Not like that.

Shiny things aren't separate from shining — even the different part doesn't get a second shine. Drop the death-grip on how stuff breaks. Dreams are just plays, no jumpscare. Decide first: knowing, doing, measuring — then answer me, teach: what makes you not-a-rock? Rocks throb too — so aren't you the un-split knowing house: no start, no end, ungraspable, all true?

You light up everything alive — smeared? So what. Shine or not, you stay whole — forever woke, both ways. Eyes past every target. God-cosplay without God is fraud. Where all is awake-as-one: no outside, no inside either.
Wanting boils up — whatever flashes, clock that. Start, middle, end — be there, shine, shine, everything melts into you.
